<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogRootEmits, AlertDialogRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogRootProps {}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogRootEmits {}

defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Root v-slot="slotProps">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </AlertDialog.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogCloseProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import type { ButtonVariants } from '@/styles/vase-luma/ui/button'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { buttonVariants } from '@/styles/vase-luma/ui/button'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogCloseProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  variant?: ButtonVariants['variant']
  size?: ButtonVariants['size']
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Close
    data-slot="alert-dialog-action"
    :class="cn('', buttonVariants({ variant, size }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialog.Close>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogCloseProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import type { ButtonVariants } from '@/styles/vase-luma/ui/button'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { buttonVariants } from '@/styles/vase-luma/ui/button'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogCloseProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  variant?: ButtonVariants['variant']
  size?: ButtonVariants['size']
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  variant: 'outline',
  size: 'default',
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Close
    data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"
    :class="cn(
      '',
      buttonVariants({ variant, size }),
      props.class,
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialog.Close>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogPopupProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogPopupProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  size?: 'default' | 'sm'
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  size: 'default',
})

function onBeforeEnter(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-closed')
  el.setAttribute('data-open', '')
}

function onBeforeLeave(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-open')
  el.setAttribute('data-closed', '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Portal>
    <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
      <AlertDialog.Backdrop
        data-slot="alert-dialog-overlay"
        class="data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 bg-black/30 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-sm fixed inset-0 z-50"
      />
    </Transition>
    <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
      <AlertDialog.Popup
        data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
        :data-size="size"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        :class="
          cn(
            'data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-open:zoom-in-95 bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-foreground/5 dark:ring-foreground/10 gap-6 rounded-4xl p-6 shadow-xl ring-1 duration-100 data-[size=default]:max-w-xs data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs data-[size=default]:sm:max-w-md group/alert-dialog-content fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 outline-none',
            props.class,
          )
        "
      >
        <slot />
      </AlertDialog.Popup>
    </Transition>
  </AlertDialog.Portal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">

import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'

</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Description
    data-slot="alert-dialog-description"

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogTitleProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogTitleProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Title
    data-slot="alert-dialog-title"
    :class="cn('text-lg font-medium sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:group-has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]/alert-dialog-content:col-start-2 cn-font-heading', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialog.Title>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AlertDialogTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { AlertDialog } from '@vase-ui/vue/alert-dialog'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ AlertDialogTriggerProps {}

defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger ref="part" data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger">
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </AlertDialog.Trigger>
</template>

export { default as AlertDialog } from './AlertDialog.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogAction } from './AlertDialogAction.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogCancel } from './AlertDialogCancel.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogContent } from './AlertDialogContent.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogDescription } from './AlertDialogDescription.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogFooter } from './AlertDialogFooter.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogHeader } from './AlertDialogHeader.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogMedia } from './AlertDialogMedia.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogTitle } from './AlertDialogTitle.vue'
export { default as AlertDialogTrigger } from './AlertDialogTrigger.vue'
